name: paperbridge-care-monitor
description: Caregiver inbox for PaperBridge paper care cards: adherence, missed-dose and symptom alerts, plus an agent that drafts the check-in call.
author: meenanoolu
highlights: Collects PaperBridge Weekly Care Card scan alerts in one caregiver inbox
Adherence %, missed doses, symptom days, and unclear marks at a glance
Sidebar badge counts alerts that still need review
One click drafts a caregiver check-in with the care-auditor agent
Aggregate data only: no card images or raw bubbles leave PaperBridge
Try it instantly with the built-in demo alert

commands.title: Audit latest PaperBridge care card
commands.subtitle: Draft a caregiver check-in
commands.prompt: Load the adherence-analysis skill. Review the most recent PaperBridge Weekly Care Card alert I share or paste here (the paperbridge:scan-alert JSON from the PaperBridge Care page), then draft a short, warm caregiver check-in: what went well, what to ask about, and anything that needs a call to the doctor.
